name: mill-ionaire
features: Simulated vertical knee mill with table moves on X, Y and Z at 0.1, 1, 5 and 10 step sizes.
Tool picker covers end mill, ball nose, drill, face mill and slot drill, with feed on and off.
Demo mode cuts the alphabet automatically.
Factory floor shift mode, call the millwright to repair, stow loose parts and empty the inventory bins.
